models: exact frozen Chapter 2 logistic and 120 depth-two error trees

arms.equal_leaf: one minus fraction of trees sharing a leaf; float32 original PAM matrix
arms.gain_leaf: one minus shared-leaf agreement weighted by sum of internal-node split gains per tree
arms.leaf_output: Euclidean distance in tree-leaf indicator coordinates weighted by fitted leaf values; shared-leaf kernel weights are squared values; no normalization or extra shrinkage

pam_pool: same saved 3000 discovery indices in same order
selection: largest mean discovery Brier among clusters with n>=50 and share>=0.01; lowest cluster ID breaks ties
primary: leaf_output minus equal_leaf selected-region Brier contrast versus rest
secondary: gain_leaf minus equal_leaf selected-region Brier contrast versus rest
inference: 5-claim Bonferroni simultaneous 95% normal intervals: three selected contrasts and two paired differences; conditional on frozen fits and selections
descriptive: all cluster sizes, Brier, event rates and AUC
adjusted Rand index of complete partitions
scope: one fixed data draw, one fixed PAM pool and deterministic initialization; different region sizes; no universal geometry ranking
restrictions: no confirmation-based model or region reselection
no numerical medoid optimization or LLM call
